faq.items.q: What is your experience in web development?

faq.items.q: How do you handle deadlines and communication during a project?
faq.items.a: Communication is key in my projects. I use project management tools to keep clients updated. I set clear milestones and communicate regularly via weekly meetings and email updates.

faq.items.q: Can you work on long-term projects or do you prefer short contracts?
faq.items.a: I'm flexible and can adapt to both long-term projects and short contracts. My goal is to provide the best value regardless of the project's length.
